fact: 1947年法国处于第四共和国初期：1946年10月宪法公投通过，1947年1月莱昂·布鲁姆（Léon Blum）组成首届临时政府，随后保罗·拉马迪埃（Paul Ramadier）组阁；政治不稳定与经济重建并行。

sources.title: Remarks by the Secretary of State at Harvard University on June 5, 1947 — George C. Marshall Foundation
sources.quote: The truth of the matter is that Europe's requirements for the next three or four years of foreign food and other essential products--principally from America--are so much greater than her present ability to pay that she must have substantial additional help.

fact: 1947年法国参与马歇尔计划：1947年7月法国与英国共同邀请苏联参加巴黎欧洲经济会议，苏联拒绝后，法英等16国于9月提出欧洲复兴方案；1948年4月马歇尔计划立法后，法国成为仅次于英国的第二大受援国。

sources.title: Marshall Plan 1947-1997: A German View — George C. Marshall Foundation
sources.quote: Our policy is not directed against any country or doctrine but against hunger, poverty, desperation and chaos. Its purpose should be the revival of a working economy in the world so as to permit the emergence of political and social conditions in which free institutions can exist.

fact: 1947年法国战后重建依赖国家指令经济：雷诺汽车、煤矿、电力、铁路在1944-1946年已被国有化；1947年法国通过第一个「蒙内计划」（Monnet Plan），由国家主导投资钢铁、机械与能源。
